def solve():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    T = int(input[0])
    for i in range(1, T+1):
        S = input[i]
        w_pos = S.index('W')
        left_blacks = w_pos
        right_blacks = len(S) - w_pos - 1
        if (left_blacks == 0 and right_blacks == 0) or (left_blacks > 0 and right_blacks > 0):
            print("Chef")
        else:
            print("Aleksa")

solve()
